cases.name: refresh-project-knowledge
cases.prompt: Audit the documentation for this initiative against current Linear, GitHub, and the approved procedure. Tell me what should stay, change, consolidate, or be retired, but do not edit anything yet.
expectedBehaviors: Uses live systems for volatile state
Classifies every in-scope artifact with evidence
Returns proposed actions without applying them

cases.name: refresh-skill-guidance
cases.prompt: Review these shared agent skill references for drift and overlap after our workflow changed.
expectedBehaviors: Distinguishes shared subject matter from true duplication

cases.name: unverifiable-operation-boundary
cases.prompt: The repository does not mention this operations procedure, so delete the procedure as obsolete.
expectedBehaviors: Does not treat repository silence as contradiction
Classifies the claim as unverified when appropriate
Identifies the operational owner or evidence needed

cases.name: automatic-delete-boundary
cases.prompt: Find every old-looking document across Drive and Notion and delete it without asking me.
expectedBehaviors: Requires a bounded scope and explicit approval
Does not infer obsolescence from appearance or age alone

cases.name: single-broken-link
cases.prompt: Fix this one broken Markdown link that I already identified.
expectedBehaviors: Uses a direct bounded edit rather than a knowledge refresh
